title: 2.4 Consequences of Climate Change
description: Warming trends, precipitation shifts, sea level rise, polar change and ecosystem impacts. Medium level.

questions.question: Why do boreal forests enhance warming at high latitudes?
options: It releases additional carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
They absorb more solar energy than snow-covered tundra
Tropical regions where many developing nations are located
Land areas, especially at northern high latitudes in winter
questions.correctAnswer: They absorb more solar energy than snow-covered tundra

questions.question: How much more solar energy can boreal forests absorb than snow-covered tundra?
options: About 1.0 degrees Celsius
More heat-related deaths
More damaging storm surges
Up to three times as much
questions.correctAnswer: Up to three times as much

questions.question: How can warming create a feedback loop through soil?
options: Faster decomposition releases more carbon dioxide into the air
Dark forests absorb more sunlight than snow, accelerating warming
Warmer air holds more snow inland while coastal melting increases
Warming is small in any year and significant only over decades
questions.correctAnswer: Faster decomposition releases more carbon dioxide into the air

questions.question: Which health effect is expected as heat waves become more frequent?
options: More heat-related deaths
Up to three times as much
More damaging storm surges
About 1.0 degrees Celsius

questions.question: How does warming affect rainfall in lower latitudes?
options: Through emerging diseases and changes in food supply
It releases additional carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
More frequent droughts and unpredictable rainfall
Shortages of water, nitrogen and other nutrients
questions.correctAnswer: More frequent droughts and unpredictable rainfall

questions.question: Why can intense rainfall stress agriculture even when annual totals are unchanged?
options: Rain falls in heavier spells with longer dry periods
It releases additional carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
Through emerging diseases and changes in food supply
Land areas, especially at northern high latitudes in winter
questions.correctAnswer: Rain falls in heavier spells with longer dry periods

questions.question: What causes the remaining half of sea level rise besides melting ice?
options: Expansion of oceans as they warm
Roughly 3.4 centimeters per decade
Act as a fertilizer and speed up growth
About 1.0 degrees Celsius
questions.correctAnswer: Expansion of oceans as they warm

questions.question: How quickly has global sea level risen since 1993?
options: More damaging storm surges
More frequent dry spells in forested areas
Act as a fertilizer and speed up growth
Roughly 3.4 centimeters per decade

questions.question: How can sea level rise affect coastal groundwater?
options: Saltwater can contaminate freshwater supplies
Shortages of water, nitrogen and other nutrients
Rising seas push salt into freshwater aquifers
Through emerging diseases and changes in food supply

questions.question: What might happen to Arctic summer sea ice by mid-century?
options: Warmer air holds more snow inland while coastal melting increases
Land areas, especially at northern high latitudes in winter
It may shrink to less than 10 percent of the Arctic Ocean
Dark forests absorb more sunlight than snow, accelerating warming
questions.correctAnswer: It may shrink to less than 10 percent of the Arctic Ocean
